items.statement: Strategies that change the ordering system, alone or with feedback on clinicians' own ordering, reduce low-value preoperative testing more, and for longer, than education or patient materials alone, without increasing same-day cancellations.
items.rationale: Consistent with c1, c2, c4 and c5; directly informs the committee's choice.
items.risks: Few direct comparisons; conclusions will rest on indirect contrasts.

items.statement: Nurse-led triage in the pre-anaesthesia clinic reduces testing as much as order set changes.
items.rationale: One observational study suggests a large effect; worth extracting as a separate strategy.
items.risks: Confounded by staffing and case mix.

summary: h1 selected as the review's organising proposition.
